cocoa-husk.$description: Cocoa Husk — Primary page canvas, body text on light surfaces, large display type on pink fields

neon-orchid.$description: Neon Orchid — Signature accent — massive display headlines on dark sections, body links, icon strokes, tag fills, the dominant brand voice

petal-wash.$description: Petal Wash — Light section canvas, button label text on dark fields, badge text

plum-velvet.$description: Plum Velvet — Deepest accent surface — section backgrounds that sit between the cocoa base and neon pink, creates tonal depth in the surface stack

bubblegum-blush.$description: Bubblegum Blush — Soft pink surface for cards, footer panels, and the lighter half of alternating section bands

lavender-haze.$description: Lavender Haze — Muted violet fill for decorative graphic elements, secondary illustration accent

magenta-spark.$description: Magenta Spark — Rare hot violet for standout card backgrounds — used sparingly to break the pink monotony

oxblood-rust.$description: Oxblood Rust — Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

lilac-whisper.$description: Lilac Whisper — Near-white lavender for button text and borders on dark surfaces, ghost-control labels

walnut-vein.$description: Walnut Vein — Muted warm gray for badge borders and hairline dividers — a lighter cocoa for subtle structural lines

times.$description: Times — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

gt-planar.$description: Primary display and body typeface. Weight 300 is reserved for the 95px display headlines, weight 700 drives 42-59px section headings, weight 400 carries 16-22px body. Tight negative tracking at -0.04em on display and -0.02em on sub-display is a signature choice — the letters compress into each other for a sculptural, almost condensed feel

abcrepromono.$description: Monospaced micro-labels for uppercase eyebrow text above headlines, badge tags, and section markers. Line-height 0.79 is aggressive — these labels sit tight and act as typographic punctuation

suisseintl.$description: UI micro-text for nav links, icon-adjacent labels, and small interactive elements. Acts as a secondary voice to GT-Planar for interface chrome
